findings: The book says natural killer cells 'are a type of T-lymphocytes and are also called cytotoxic T-cells'. NK cells are innate lymphocytes distinct from T cells, and cytotoxic T cells are the specific cells of topic 21.3.2. The lesson reports the book and corrects this in a note, flagged.
The book says macrophages kill with 'lysozyme enzymes'; the lesson says enzymes (lysosomal enzymes). The For Information box on self-proteins is carried.
